audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes named item spikes with no cooldowns and attributed Gwen's healing to the wrong ability.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22s at rank 1 down to 18s. Skip 'n Slash is 13s and is partially refunded when she hits an enemy during it. Needlework is 120/100/80s and casts up to three times. The health-scaling damage that heals her is A Thousand Cuts, her passive — Snip Snip! is magic damage with true damage down the centre.
audit.corrected: Real timers written into spikes[1], spikes[3], breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d; the passive re-attributed in spikes[3], late and whys[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Infinite Duress is called a point-and-click fight starter in three places, and Hallowed Mist is described as making Gwen untargetable full stop.
audit.why: Riot's text makes Infinite Duress a directional leap that suppresses the first champion it collides with, its distance scaling with bonus Move Speed. Riot's text for Hallowed Mist says she can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist — so the counterplay is to walk into the cloud, not to wait outside it. The mirror agent made the same reframing on Gwen's page.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why, breakdown.late, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and spikes[1] rewritten around the leap and the step-inside rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: Gwen is referred to as 'he'/'his' in tradeGood, tradeBad, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.trading, report[3], breakdown.feeding, report[12], breakdown.late and report[8].
audit.why: Gwen is female. Ten pronoun errors on one matchup page reads as machine-generated and undermines the rest of the advice.
audit.corrected: All ten corrected in the same edits that carry the mechanical improvements.

The substantive fixes here are the ten Gwen-as-'he' pronoun errors, Infinite Duress being a directional leap rather than point-and-click, the step-inside-the-mist rule from Riot's own Hallowed Mist text, and the healing being A Thousand Cuts rather than Snip Snip!.
